name: Tiny Titans Visual UX Contract
purpose: Keep visual identity consistent while allowing each page to use the composition best suited to its job.
principles: Every page has a clear primary purpose.
Pages may use different compositions; visual identity must remain recognisably Tiny Titans.
Interactive tiles must have a real action or destination.
Information density must match the task rather than maximising content on screen.
Mobile is a first-class layout, not a compressed desktop layout.
Primary actions must be visually obvious.
Decorative UI must never masquerade as functional UI.
Progressive disclosure should be preferred over dashboard overload.
Visual findings must be backed by rendered evidence where possible.
The visual bot recommends changes; it never silently edits production code.
